responsibility: This AWK generator builds the static C runtime name-mapping table used by the VMS target support code. It reads a sorted textual list of CRTL entry names and flag tags, verifies the input ordering, emits C initializer entries of the form used by vms.cc, and computes the maximum source-name length for the companion VMS_CRTL_MAXLEN macro that sizes translation buffers in the generated aliasing logic.
